title: Cut-back danger
text: An attacker has reached your byline. Another attacker is running into the middle. You're sprinting back.
tip: When the ball goes wide, protect the middle.

options.text: Get to the space in front of goal to block the pull-back
options.why: Pull-backs are the danger. You need to be between that runner and the ball.

options.text: Run over to help on the ball
options.why: Your teammate is already there. Now the runner is free.
The runner will beat you to it.
